text:
All requested Gate 2 revisions have been applied and verified:

1. **`U01` (`packages/excalidraw/data/reconcile.ts` in `units-001.json`):** Added optional third parameter `elements?: readonly ExcalidrawElement[]` to `reconcilePages` so local pages missing from `remotePages` are kept when non-deleted elements are still on them (`AC-12`).
2. **`U02` (`packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx` in `units-002.json`):** Replaced `this.store.scheduleCapture();` with `this.store.scheduleAction(CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER);` inside `addPage` (line 5425) so the page-list change does not land on the newly created page's undo stack and a new page starts with an empty undo stack (`FR-6`).
3. **`U03` & `U04` (`excalidraw-app/data/firebase.ts` and `excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx` in `units-003.json`):** Passed `reconciledElements` / `elements` as the third argument to `reconcilePages` at `firebase.ts:298` and `Collab.tsx:632,789,810,901`.
4. **`U05` (`packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx` in `units-004.json`):** Replaced `h.scene.getAllElementsIncludingInactivePages()` with `h.scene.getAllNonDeletedElements()` / `h.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted()`, replaced `h.app.selectAll()` with `h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionSelectAll)`, aligned `PageBar` rename/reorder `data-testid` queries and `reorderPages(0, 1)`, and restored the `vitest` check.
5. **`U06` (`excalidraw-app/tests/pages.test.tsx` in `units-005.json`):** Updated the share-link `fetch` mock so `GET` requests return the stored bytes regardless of the URL's form, and restored the `vitest` check.
